## Required every-run proof
- [ ] Plan file/ref and precise subsection/requirement + core user path
- [ ] Before -> after stage and commit/changed behavior
- [ ] Core-function advancement + currently usable status
- [ ] Reuse candidates/provenance/license/safety, adapted vs scratch with reasons
- [ ] Original exact-SHA CI/tests, live/deployment proof or unverified

See AGENTS.md. Preserve existing approvals and security holds.
